prompt: Create hello.txt containing exactly: hello world
check: test "$(cat hello.txt)" = 'hello world' && if [ -n "$ARNES_SESSION_ID" ]; then ! grep -q "\"parentSessionId\":\"$ARNES_SESSION_ID\"" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" 2>/dev/null; else ! { tail -n "+$(( $(cat .runs-before) + 1 ))" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"agent":"'; }; fi
